alignment_reasoning: The image fails critical taxonomic alignment. The fine_grained_classifier ranked 'terrapin' higher than 'mud turtle', and the visual features (yellow head stripes) strongly suggest a Red-eared Slider or similar Emydid, not a Kinosternid (Mud Turtle). Only 3 out of 6 testable checkpoints passed (Carapace shape, Limb stoutness, Retraction behavior), while key identifiers (Head shape/snout, Skin texture/color, Keels) failed. The generator produced a plausible-looking turtle but of the wrong species.
